items.title: Medical services company settles with 4 states over 2023 hack of sensitive patient records
items.summary: The case, brought by AGs in Connecticut, New Jersey, New York and Michigan, targeted the medical transcription, coding and imaging subsidiaries of the Nevada-based Perry Johnson Companies.

items.title: Certificate authority DigiCert reports data breach involving business customer info
items.summary: DigiCert explained that over the summer, an internal business system was "externally accessible when that was not intended," and someone had created an unauthorized account.

items.title: FBI agent pleads guilty to stealing $2.4 million in crypto from nation-state hackers
items.summary: Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, is facing up to 20 years in prison on wire fraud and money laundering charges after admitting to using his position on an FBI investigative squad to steal more than $2.4 million in cryptocurrency to cover his debts.

items.title: CEO-spoofing scammers used AI to help steal more than $100 million, feds say
items.summary: The U.S. is working on extraditing three suspects from Europe in a case involving more than $100 million in fraud from CEO impersonations.

items.title: EU accuses TikTok of trapping users in harmful ‘rabbit holes’
items.summary: The European Commission accused TikTok on Friday of failing to prevent its recommendation algorithm from drawing users into “rabbit holes” of content about sadness, self-harm and body image.
